comment: Legacy rendered items that are NOT authored content and are intentionally not reproduced. Everything else in docs/inventory/legacy-rendered.json must appear in the new output. Add a rule only with a reason; never to make a failing check pass.

blocks.reason: legacy layout date/read-time line; the approved design has its own meta line (date is checked via <time>)
legacy layout 'part of series' banner; the approved design has series navigation
legacy layout share/report section (the approved design removes the layout's copy of Contribution)
blocks.pattern: ^(Enjoyed the article, found it useful|Found a mistake\?)

blocks.reason: comments are omitted by owner decision (data kept in _data/comments)
blocks.pattern: ^(Comments|Leave a Comment|All comments are held for moderation|Antoinette|October 4, 2021|Touche\. Great arguments|Here is my site)

blocks.reason: legacy home 'browse' sidebar lists; the approved home has Explore by subject (all tags remain reachable, checked separately)
boilerplate excerpt of the legacy tag layout
approved design does not display the page date on Terms; front matter is untouched
legacy 404 copy; the approved design has its own 404 page
blocks.pattern: ^(404|Page not found :\(|The requested page could not be found\.)$

blocks.reason: legacy home heading; the approved home has its own section headings
legacy layout 'Contribution' heading (only exempt when the Markdown has no such heading; the checker enforces that)

links.reason: legacy layout share/report/footer/series/topic links not present in the Markdown (topics checked separately)
comment form help links and comment anchors (comments omitted by owner decision)
tag chips on list cards: the approved design shows at most 3 per card; every tag stays linked from the home page (checked) and the article page
